about.title: Yountville Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Yountville is a small town, about 3,017 residents along Washington Street and the SR-29 corridor through Napa Valley. In the most recent final crash year, 2025, the town recorded three injury collisions with four people hurt and no traffic deaths. Still, a wrongful death claim is rarely about statistics. It is about one family, one empty chair. Fatal losses here may follow a crash on Route 29 or California Drive, a fall at a hospitality property, a defective product, or medical negligence, and the civil claim that follows is separate from any criminal case. Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and the children stand first in line to bring the claim, with certain dependents and heirs eligible after them. Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. The deadline is two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive connects Yountville families with an independent attorney at no cost; the attorney works on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Yountville Families Start With LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney sorts out eligibility early so no one in the family is left out or surprised later.

items.title: The clock is real, and sometimes shorter
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but when a city, county, or state agency is involved, the window is far tighter. Connecting quickly protects your options.

items.title: A civil case on its own track
items.desc: Whether or not criminal charges are filed, a wrongful death action proceeds separately and seeks compensation for funeral costs, lost support, and the loss of companionship. The attorneys in our network handle these claims on contingency, with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative died after a crash on SR-29 near Yountville. Does it matter that the town reported no traffic deaths in 2025?
items.answer: Not for your claim. Public collision counts describe a year for the town as a whole; they say nothing about whether another driver, a vehicle defect, or a road condition contributed to your loss. An attorney evaluates the facts of your case, including where on Route 29 it happened and which agency or party may bear responsibility.

items.question: We are still waiting on the criminal investigation. Should we hold off on a civil claim?
items.answer: Waiting is usually not necessary, and it can be risky. A wrongful death case is a civil action that moves independently of any criminal matter, and its two-year deadline does not pause while prosecutors decide what to do. An attorney can preserve evidence and meet deadlines while the other process runs.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: The surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children come first. If there are none, certain dependents and heirs may qualify, and the rules can get detailed when there are stepchildren, parents, or blended families. This is one of the first things an attorney will help you work through.
